item.title: SOLID Patterns: My lessons on it
item.description: SOLID Patterns are a general guideline and recommended patterns that you can use in your codebase to be extensible, easy to modify in the future, and easy to fix. These aren't hard-bound rules just general recommendations. Here, I'll talk about them in detail.
